title: Pride that boils over
odia:
କ୍ଷୀର ଉତୁରିଲେ ଚୁଲିକୁ,
ମଣିଷ ଉତୁରିଲେ ଗାତକୁ...!!!
literal_meaning: When milk boils over, it spills onto the hearth; when a person goes too far, into the pit.
explanation: The first line supplies an everyday overflow; the second turns it into a warning about arrogance. The source explicitly frames the saying as a response to excessive pride. Its sharp downward ending suggests that losing restraint can bring a fall.
meaning_odia: ଦୁଧ ଉତୁରିବାର ଚିତ୍ର ସହ ଅତି ଗର୍ବର ପରିଣାମକୁ ମେଳାଯାଇଛି। ନିଜକୁ ବହୁତ ବଡ଼ ଭାବି ସଂଯମ ହରାଇଲେ ଅସୁବିଧା ହୋଇପାରେ—ଏହା ହିଁ ସତର୍କତା। ଆତ୍ମବିଶ୍ୱାସ ଓ ଅହଂକାର ମଧ୍ୟରେ ତଫାତ ଅଛି; ସଫଳତାରେ ଖୁସି ହେବାକୁ କଥାଟି ମନା କରେନାହିଁ।
usage_example: A successful team member begins dismissing everyone else’s advice, and a colleague warns against letting success become arrogance. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The comparison is between two kinds of overstepping. It is a figurative warning, not a prediction that every proud person will suffer a particular fate. The source’s digital punctuation is preserved.

variants.odia:
ବାଉଁଶ ଫୁଲରେ ମରେ
ମଣିଷ ଫୁଲିଲେ ମରେ।
variants.locator: Page30, seventh item beginning ବାଉଁଶ ଫୁଲରେ.
variants.note: Related-family variant grouped editorially with the milk-overflow/person-downfall saying POD-DHAGA-034; historical descent unknown. Literal: Bamboo dies through flowering; a person dies when puffed up. ଅର୍ଥ: ବାଉଁଶ ଫୁଲ ଧରିଲେ ମରେ, ମଣିଷ ଗର୍ବରେ ଫୁଲିଲେ ମରେ—ପଙ୍କ୍ତିର ବକ୍ତା ଏହି ତୁଳନା କରୁଛନ୍ତି। ଫୁଲ ଓ ଫୁଲିବାର ଶବ୍ଦଖେଳରେ ଅହଂକାରର କ୍ଷତିକୁ ତୀବ୍ର କରି କୁହାଯାଇଛି। ମଣିଷର ଫୁଲିବାକୁ ଏଠାରେ ଗର୍ବ ଭାବେ ପଢ଼ାଯାଇଛି; ଏହା ଦେହର ରୋଗ ବିଷୟରେ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ନୁହେଁ। Explanation: The sound of flowering passes into being puffed up, turning a plant image into a warning about pride. Both lines end in death, giving the comparison its severity. Our editorial reading takes that human endpoint as the saying’s forceful image of ruin through arrogance. Source: uploaded compilation page30, inspected17November2026; exact ଫୁଲରେ/ଫୁଲିଲେ contrast retained. Bamboo statement belongs to the proverbial image, without a universal biological claim. Source quotation excluded from collection CC licensing; upload licence unknown.
